explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/660 (and [93]): Altman proved that the vertices of a convex n-gon determine at least n/2 distinct distances. In the precise form this is ⌊n/2⌋, attained by the regular polygon, and the statement uses natural division n / 2 ≤ distinctDistances. Convex position plus full affine span in ℝ² is exactly the vertex set of a convex polygon. Faithful.
